lines.japanese: で、その鳳だ。
lines.english: Which brought me back to Kakeru.

lines.japanese: ヘテロにいなかった、ってことは家で寝てンのか？
lines.english: If he wasn't at Hetero, was he home asleep?

lines.japanese: とりあえず電話してみた。
lines.english: I tried calling him.

lines.japanese: なかなか出ない。しつこく待っていると、２０コール目ぐらいでようやく返事があった。
lines.english: He didn't answer for ages. I stubbornly let it ring, and somewhere around the twentieth time, he finally picked up.

lines.japanese: 『うるせえ。あきらめ悪いよ、おまえ』
lines.english: “You're annoying. Learn when to give up.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、なんだよ、いるんじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Oh, come on. You were there after all.”

lines.japanese: 『いても出たくないときあんだろ。読めよ、そんぐらい』
lines.english: “Sometimes I'm there and don't wanna answer. Read the room.”

lines.japanese: 皇帝陛下はなにやら御機嫌よろしくない様子。
lines.english: His Imperial Majesty did not appear to be in the best of moods.

lines.japanese: 『なに。いま作業中なんだけど』
lines.english: “What? I'm working.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、いや……おまえ、いまどこ」
lines.english: “Uh, right... Where are you?”

lines.japanese: 『アトリエ』
lines.english: “Atelier.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　阿戸理恵？　誰だ、女といンのか。裏Ｙ１グランプリか」
lines.english: “Huh? At Ellie A.’s? Who’s she? You’re with a girl? Having that secret Y1 Grand Prix?”

lines.japanese: 『そう』
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: そうじゃねーだろ、適当ぶっこくんじゃねえよ。
lines.english: No, you aren't. Don't just make shit up.

lines.japanese: 「どこにあんだよ、その阿戸さん家は」
lines.english: “So where does this Ellie live?”

lines.japanese: 『この世の果て』
lines.english: “At the end of the world.”

lines.japanese: まともに答える気ねーな、こいつ。
lines.english: He had no intention of giving me a straight answer.

lines.japanese: 「ま、いいや。なあ、ちょっと頼みあんだけど──」
lines.english: “Whatever. Listen, I've got a favor to ask—”

lines.japanese: さすがに盗聴の可能性を危惧するわけじゃないが、内容が内容だけに、どうにも電話じゃまだるっこしい。
lines.english: I wasn't seriously worried about someone tapping the phone, but this wasn't the kind of thing I could easily explain over a call.

lines.japanese: 「──あんさ、いまから会えねえ？」
lines.english: “—could we meet up now?”

lines.japanese: 『いまから？　無理だね。明日にして』
lines.english: “Now? No. Make it tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、なるべく早い方がいんだけど」
lines.english: “I'd rather do it as soon as possible.”

lines.japanese: 『無理だ、つってんじゃん。じゃあね、シーユートゥモロ～♪』
lines.english: “I said no. See you tomorrooow.”

lines.japanese: 取りつく島もなかった。
lines.english: There was no getting through to him.

lines.japanese: バッグを手に呆けていると、聞き覚えのある太鼓の音が、冬の風に乗ってやってきた。
lines.english: As I stood there blankly with the bag, the familiar sound of a drum came riding on the winter wind.

lines.japanese: 「カラスか……」
lines.english: “Raven...?”

lines.japanese: もしやと思い、ガード下の陰気なライブ会場へ足を向けた。
lines.english: Wondering if it could be him, I headed toward the dreary performance space beneath the overpass.

lines.japanese: フェニックスとレイヴン。
lines.english: The Phoenix and the Raven.

lines.japanese: なんだかんだ言って仲良くケンカしているふたりだ、互いの所在ぐらい知っているかもしれない。
lines.english: For all their bickering, those two got along. He might at least know where the other was.

lines.japanese: ガード下には褐色の演奏者のグルーピーたちが半円形の人垣を作っていた。
lines.english: Beneath the overpass, the dark-skinned musician's groupies stood in a semicircle around him.

lines.japanese: ざっと見渡してみたが、会話を交わしたことのある顔はいない。仕方ない。俺は嫌悪感丸出しの視線を浴びつつ、信者連中を掻きわけて中心部へ踊りでた。
lines.english: I scanned the crowd, but I didn't recognize anyone I'd spoken to before. Nothing for it. Bathed in undisguised looks of disgust, I forced my way through the faithful and strode into the center.

lines.japanese: 周囲から、攻撃的な視線が向けられるのを感じた。しかし俺が演者の縁者だと分かると、それも消えていった。
lines.english: I felt hostile eyes turn toward me from every direction. Once they realized I was a pal of the player, the hostility faded.

lines.japanese: 「おう。久しぶり」
lines.english: “Yo. Been a while.”

lines.japanese: 「誰だ……ハヤブサか」
lines.english: “Who are you...? Falcon?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 俺が成田隼人としてこいつに会うのは久しぶりだったが、向こうがこの顔を見る機会はそう珍しくもないのだろう。
lines.english: It had been a long time since I'd met him as Hayato Narita, but seeing this face probably wasn't so rare for him.

lines.japanese: なにしろこいつは“羽田鷹志”の同級生だったのだから。
lines.english: After all, he'd been a classmate of Takashi Haneda.

lines.japanese: 「あんたンとこのいじけた兄弟に伝えてくれよ。卒業文集の寄せ書き、おまえンとこだけ空きっぱなしだってなァ」
lines.english: “Tell that sulking brother of yours that his space in the graduation yearbook is still empty.”

lines.japanese: 「やつのお姫さまも不審がってる……いや、ありゃ寂しがってるってやつかねえ」
lines.english: “His princess is getting suspicious too... No. Maybe ‘lonely’ is the word.”

lines.japanese: やつの言葉がトリガーになって、タカシだった俺の記憶がよみがえってくる。灰色の学園生活。
lines.english: His words pulled the trigger, and memories from when I'd been Takashi came back to me. A gray school life.

lines.japanese: 「んだテメ、この糞カラス。おまえだって、学校ほとんど来てなかったじゃねえか。なに他人の不登校にケチ付けてんだ」
lines.english: “The fuck, you shitty Raven? You barely came to school yourself. Who are you to give somebody else shit for not going?”

lines.japanese: 「いつ俺が非難したって？　ただ親切にも事実を伝えてやっただけでしょう、チキンボーイズ」
lines.english: “When did I criticize him? I merely did you Chicken Boys the kindness of stating a fact.”

lines.japanese: 年上の同級生が口の端を吊りあげて笑う。相変わらずの屁理屈口調。だからこいつに会うのは面倒だったんだ。
lines.english: My older classmate grinned, one corner of his mouth curling upward. The same sophistry as ever. This was why seeing him was such a pain in the ass.

lines.japanese: しかし、もちろん俺はこの程度で腹を立てたりしない。しゃがみ込んで、視線の高さをやつに合わせた。
lines.english: Naturally, I wasn't going to get angry over something so trivial. I crouched to bring my eyes level with his.

lines.japanese: 「今日はなんの用だい、スラムの王。わけもなく俺のところへ来たわけじゃないんでしょう」
lines.english: “What brings you here today, King of the Slums? Surely you didn't come to see me without a reason.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、分かってんなら、最初からつまんねえ絡み方してくンじゃねえよ。つうか――」
lines.english: “If you know that, don't start with the pointless shit. Anyway—”

lines.japanese: 「どうした」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「なあ、おまえ、阿戸さん家どこにあるか知らない」
lines.english: “Hey, do you know where Ellie lives?”

lines.japanese: 「どこのどなた様だい、そりゃあ。聞いたこともねえなァ」
lines.english: “And who, pray tell, is that? Never heard of her.”

lines.japanese: 「阿戸さんだよ。知らねーのかよ、鳳ンとこの阿戸理恵」
lines.english: “Ellie A. Don’t you know her? Kakeru Ohtori’s Ellie A.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、アトリエか。ハン、あんた、相変わらず鳳凰寺カケルと馴れあってンのかい」
lines.english: “Oh, his *atelier*. Hah. Still cozying up to Kakeru Hououji, are you?”

lines.japanese: 「──ってねえよ。でも色々あんだよ。いいから、どーなの。おまえ阿戸さん家、知ってんの知らないの」
lines.english: “I am not. There’s just stuff going on. So? Do you know where Ellie lives or not?”

lines.japanese: 「そういやァ、倫理的な意味で世に出せない落書きが大量にあるってんで、一度冷やかしに行ったなァ。教えてやってもいいけど」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, I went once to laugh at the mountain of drawings he could never release on ethical grounds. I can tell you where it is, but...”

lines.japanese: 「まじか」
lines.english: “Seriously?”

lines.japanese: 意外やハリュー・クロードの返答は素直だった。また面倒な駄々でも捏ねるんじゃないかと、不安だったが──
lines.english: Claude Haryuu's answer was unexpectedly straightforward. I'd been afraid he would throw one of his tiresome fits—

lines.japanese: 「ただしギブ＆テイクでいきましょう、スラムの王」
lines.english: “We do this as give-and-take, King of the Slums.”

lines.japanese: ──いや、やっぱりそう来るか。
lines.english: —and there it was.

lines.japanese: 「なに。俺あんま金持ってねーけど」
lines.english: “What do you want? I don't have much money.”

lines.japanese: 「自分の手で獲れるものを、他人に恵んでもらおうとは思わない。そんなものはいらねえよ」
lines.english: “I don't want another man to hand me what I can take with my own hands. Keep your money.”

lines.japanese: 「なァ、知ってンのかい、ファルコンボーイ。俺たちは、あんたじゃないあんたと、別れぎわ再会の約定を結んだンだ」
lines.english: “Did you know, Falcon Boy, that when we parted, we made a covenant with a you who isn’t you? A promise that we would meet again.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　誰のことだ」
lines.english: “Huh? Who?”

lines.japanese: 「あんたの中に、ひとりいるでしょう、いかにも俺や鳳凰寺カケルが飛びつきそうな、最高にファックな陛下が」
lines.english: “There's someone inside you, isn't there? The perfect, utterly fucked-up sovereign that Kakeru Hououji and I would both leap at.”

lines.japanese: 「……やつか」
伊丹伽楼羅。憎悪と怨嗟を司るもの。
lines.english: Karura Itami. The being who presided over hatred and malice.

lines.japanese: 俺は露骨に不快感を表してみせた。陛下という単語がトリガーになって、俺じゃない俺の記憶がよみがえる。
lines.english: I let my displeasure show openly. The word *sovereign* pulled the trigger, and memories belonging to a me who wasn't me came flooding back.

lines.japanese: 俺と鳳とこいつ。路地裏の遊戯。
lines.english: Kakeru, him, and me. A game in a back alley.

lines.japanese: 「無理だ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 俺の答えは、考えるまでもない。
lines.english: I didn't need to think about the answer.

lines.japanese: 「事情があって、やつは出せない。約束を守れなかったことは謝る、悪いが他の条件にしてくれ」
lines.english: “There are circumstances. I can't let him out. I'm sorry we couldn't keep the promise, but you'll have to name another price.”

lines.japanese: やつは目を閉じて長い息を吐いた。
lines.english: He closed his eyes and let out a long breath.

lines.japanese: 「なら、委員長は」
lines.english: “Then the class representative?”

lines.japanese: 「無理だ。もう他のやつは出せない」
lines.english: “No. I can't let any of the others out anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、そういうことかい」
lines.english: “Hah. So that's how it is.”

lines.japanese: 落胆したように肩を揺らした。察しが早いのは癪にさわることもあるが、いまばかりは助かる。
lines.english: His shoulders moved with what looked like disappointment. His quick understanding could be infuriating, but for once I was grateful for it.

lines.japanese: 「だったらあんたで楽しませてもらうしかないなァ、ファッキンファルコン」
lines.english: “Then I'll have to amuse myself with you, Fucking Falcon.”

lines.japanese: 「と言っても、あいにくあんたの愉快な使い方をすぐには思いつかねえ。貸しにしておこう。ちょっと待ってろ」
lines.english: “Unfortunately, I can't immediately think of an entertaining use for you. You can owe me. Wait here.”

lines.japanese: やつはポケットからペンと手帳を取りだし、きったねえ地図を描きだした。
lines.english: He pulled a pen and notebook from his pocket and started scrawling a messy map.

lines.japanese: めくるとき、他のページに雑多な音符や単語の羅列が覗けた。いわゆるネタ帳だろうか。
lines.english: As he turned the pages, I glimpsed jumbles of musical notes and words on the others. Some kind of idea book, maybe.

lines.japanese: 「持ってけ」
lines.english: “Take it.”

lines.japanese: そのページを無造作に破りとる。俺は一言礼を言って受けとった。
lines.english: He tore out the page without ceremony. I thanked him briefly and accepted it.

lines.japanese: 「助かる。演奏の邪魔して悪かったな」
lines.english: “That helps. Sorry I interrupted your performance.”

lines.japanese: 「こっちだって、お上から許可取ってここにいるわけじゃない。世の皆さまに言わせりゃ、邪魔なのは俺の方だろうよ」
lines.english: “It's not as if the authorities gave me permission to be here. Ask respectable society, and I'm the one causing an obstruction.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん。ストリートミュージシャンってのも大変なんだな」
lines.english: “Huh. Being a street musician must be rough.”

lines.japanese: 「ふン、小遣いもらった孫かい。しおらしいこと言ってンじゃ──」
lines.english: “Hmph. What are you, a grandchild who just got his allowance? Don't start acting so meek—”

lines.japanese: 言葉の途中で、ハリュー・クロードの彷徨う瞳の動きが一瞬止まった。
lines.english: In the middle of the sentence, Claude Haryuu's wandering eyes stopped for an instant.

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なに」
lines.english: “Hm? What?”
“Ahem!”

lines.japanese: いや、単に喉が絡んだだけのようだ。やつはミネラルウォーターのボトルに口を付けた。
lines.english: No, something had merely caught in his throat. He lifted a bottle of mineral water to his lips.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、あんたも意外と人気者なんだなァ」
lines.english: “Hah. You're surprisingly popular yourself.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「まァ、せいぜい夜道を歩くときは気を付けなよ」
lines.english: “Just take care when you're walking at night.”

lines.japanese: 「なに思わせぶりなこと言ってんだよ。心当たりありすぎて笑えねえっつの」
lines.english: “What's with the cryptic bullshit? I've got too many possible enemies for that to be funny.”

lines.japanese: とはいえ、忠告だけはありがたくいただいておこう。俺は手の中の鞄を慎重に抱えなおし、年上の同級生には目潰しピースを送ってその場を去った。
lines.english: Still, I'd gratefully accept the warning. I adjusted my careful hold on the bag, gave my older classmate an eye-gouging peace sign, and left.

lines.japanese: いつの間にか俺の身元も割れていたらしい。Ｒ－ＷＩＮＧの連中は、自分たちの教祖と互角に戦った俺を粗略には扱わなかった。なんかの物語みたいに人垣が割れる。
lines.english: Apparently, the crowd had figured out who I was at some point. The R-WING faithful treated a man who had fought their messiah to a draw with due respect. The wall of people parted like something out of a story.

lines.japanese: その花道を通りながら、俺は次にハリュー・クロードと会ったときのことを考えてげんなりした。
lines.english: As I walked down that aisle, I imagined the next time I saw Claude Haryuu and felt my spirits sink.

lines.japanese: めんどくさいやつに貸しを作ってしまった。
lines.english: I'd put myself in debt to one hell of a troublesome man.

lines.japanese: いったい何を命じられるんだか。ああ面倒くせえ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。
lines.english: Who knew what he'd order me to do? What a pain in the ass. I'll fucking kill him.
